dishes.name: Beyran soup
dishes.desc: Spicy lamb and rice soup topped with pul biber and a slick of fat, eaten for breakfast in Antep. It is the city's signature morning dish and is served in dedicated beyran houses.

dishes.name: Katmer
dishes.desc: Paper-thin dough folded around clotted cream, crushed pistachios and sugar, then baked on a hot plate. A traditional Antep breakfast pastry eaten with the local pistachios.

dishes.name: Ali Nazik kebab
dishes.desc: Spiced minced lamb or cubed meat on a bed of smoked aubergine blended with garlicky yoghurt. A classic Antep kebab house dish.

dishes.name: Yuvalama
dishes.desc: Small rice-and-mince meatballs simmered in a yoghurt and chickpea broth finished with mint butter. A long-standing Antep home-style dish found in local lokantas.

dishes.name: Antep pistachio baklava
dishes.desc: Thin layers of pastry with green Antep pistachio and syrup, lighter and greener than most baklava. The city holds protected status for it and bakeries here are everywhere.
